narr: A high amplitude, negatively tilted trough moving across the Great Lakes and into New England along with cold and warm front provided strong forcing which resulted in flooding, wind damage, and 5 tornadoes. In the warm sector dewpoints surged into the mid 70s with PWATs near 2 inches which led to torrential downpours. Tornadoes occurred in Scotland, Ct, Scituate, RI, North Attleboro, MA, Stoughton, MA, and Weymouth, MA. The tornadoes ranged in intensity from EF-0 to EF-2.
ev: In Andover, stores in Shawsheen Plaza flooded.
In Billerica, several basements were flooded.
In West Newbury, there was significant street flooding across the town.
In Southbridge, several streets were flooded and impassable with cars stuck.
In Foxborough, there was 1 foot of street flooding in the right lane of 495 south.
In Bedford, there was 1 to 2 feet of standing water and submerged cars at Hanscom Air Force Base.
In Canton, North Main St at Bay Rd was flooded.
In Dorchester, portions of Southern Ave were flooded and impassable.
In Maynard, Parker St at Great Rd was flooded and impassable.
In Andover, a portion of Main St was flooded.
In Fall River, Plymouth Ave between I-95 and Pleasant St was flooded and impassable.
